name: Team Squirtle: Aerial Tides & Seismic Dominance
archetype: Ground immunities, Levitate Psychic artillery, and Intimidate Water pivots.
gym_duel_rationale: Giovanni relies on powerful Ground, Rock, and Fighting moves. When challenged, select your 5 designated Pokémon: Blastoise/Fearow (complete Ground immunity while Hydro Pump and Aqua Tail drown his Rock/Ground types), Alakazam/Weezing (Levitate grants total immunity to Earthquake while STAB Psychic obliterates his Fighting types), Jolteon/Sandslash (blazing speed and Volt Absorb to nullify Electabuzz/Dugtrio while returning lethal Earthquakes), Arbok/Primeape (Intimidate cuts physical Attack while Close Combat crushes Rhydon/Snorlax), and Lapras (Water Absorb neutralizes Surf while STAB Ice Beam freezes Giovanni's Ground titans).

roster.progression_notes: 517 BST Water/Flying juggernaut. Completely immune to Ground-type Earthquakes. High-powered STAB Hydro Pump and Aqua Tail demolish Golem/Machamp and Rhydon/Snorlax, while Roost provides reliable recovery.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate makes it 100% immune to Giovanni's Earthquakes, allowing free Calm Mind boosts and STAB Psychic sweeps against Primeape/Nidoking.
488 BST high-Speed sweeper. Volt Absorb provides an Electric immunity, completely shutting down Electabuzz/Dugtrio. STAB Earthquake flattens opposing Ground and Steel threats.
473 BST Intimidate bruiser. Weakens Giovanni's physical attackers upon entry and paralyzes threats with Glare. STAB Close Combat delivers massive super-effective damage to Rhydon/Snorlax.
Colossal 160 HP normal sponge. Body Slam provides consistent damage and paralysis, while Rest and Sleep Talk easily absorb Sandstorm and passive damage.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Water Absorb completely absorbs incoming Surf attacks, while STAB Ice Beam freezes Giovanni's Ground and Flying hybrids with super-effective damage.

flex_bench.rationale: High-bulk Grass anchor with Sleep Powder, Leech Seed, and Synthesis.
Ground-immune Water sweeper setting up Dragon Dance to sweep.
Triple Kick and Rapid Spin utility to control entry hazards.
